# appgatesdp_certificate_authority_ca_next (Data Source)

Supported SDP Admin API versions: v21, v22, v23, v24, v25.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `certificate` (String) Base64 encoded binary of the certificate. Either DER or PEM formatted depending on the request.
- `crl_url` (String) The URL where the CRL is hosted.
- `fingerprint` (String) SHA256 fingerprint of the certificate.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the data source.
- `issuer` (String) The issuer name of the certificate.
- `name_constraints_excluded` (List of String) Name constraints extension details for excluded hostnames or IPs.
- `name_constraints_permitted` (List of String) Name constraints extension details for permitted hostnames or IPs.
- `serial` (String) X.509 certificate serial number.
- `subject` (String) The subject name of the certificate.
- `subject_public_key` (String) Base64 encoded public key of the certificate.
- `valid_from` (String) Since when the certificate is valid from.
- `valid_to` (String) Until when the certificate is valid.
- `version` (Number) X.509 certificate version.
